_methodology.cost: computed from token counts at price basis {'input': 10.0, 'output': 50.0, 'cache_read': 1.0, 'cache_write_1h': 20.0} USD/1M; all cache writes verified 1h-TTL; not provider-reported
_methodology.active_hours: request timestamps clustered, gaps <= 30 min joined
_methodology.direction: user messages minus tool results, hooks, machinery, and pastes > 500 words
_methodology.overhead: requests whose tool calls all match bookkeeping patterns (provlog log/claim/validate/report/init/agent/disclosure/extract, promote/source, graph+transcript commits, exporters)
_methodology.prose_words: sections/*.tex, comments stripped, LaTeX commands stripped
